splice_trap.note: Per-date optima using different quoted blocks cannot be combined into one order, because the ordered model cannot change after submission.

fixed_cross_date_stack.guarantee: not available: no single exact stack conforms on both dates, so a fixed-stack order would over-commit beyond what the certificates support

late_assembly_locked_purchase.guarantee: the ordered block is certified on every candidate date and at least one conforming partner set exists on each date; assembly is deferred until the date is confirmed, but the same partners, bounds and margin are not promised
late_assembly_locked_purchase.does_not_guarantee: a reproducible exact stack, the per-date optimum, or identical margins

fixed_cross_date_stack.guarantee: not available: the quote does not reach every candidate date

late_assembly_locked_purchase.guarantee: only the dates listed are covered; on the remaining date no conforming partner set exists, so locking the purchase does not guarantee a usable stack everywhere
late_assembly_locked_purchase.does_not_guarantee: a reproducible exact stack, the per-date optimum, or identical margins

fixed_cross_date_stack.guarantee: not available: the quote does not reach every candidate date

late_assembly_locked_purchase.guarantee: not available: the ordered block has no conforming partner set on any candidate date under the current certificates
late_assembly_locked_purchase.does_not_guarantee: a reproducible exact stack, the per-date optimum, or identical margins

fixed_cross_date_stack.guarantee: the exact same block set is certified on every candidate date and produces identical bounds; assembly may not substitute partners, so the guarantee is reproducible but narrow

late_assembly_locked_purchase.guarantee: the ordered block is certified on every candidate date and at least one conforming partner set exists on each date; assembly is deferred until the date is confirmed, but the same partners, bounds and margin are not promised
late_assembly_locked_purchase.does_not_guarantee: a reproducible exact stack, the per-date optimum, or identical margins

same_backup_different_partners.explanation: the same ordered block pairs with different in-stock blocks on different dates; it can be ordered now because assembly is deferred, even though no single exact stack is guaranteed across dates
a fixed exact stack also exists, so this quote is a stronger fixed-stack case
